summary: London, web developer, strong expertise in Django and Python, interest in JavaScript frameworks (jQuery, Node.js), advocate for open source software, engaged in discussions about web security (XSS, CSRF), strong opinions on web standards (HTML5, CSS), experience with NoSQL databases (Redis, MongoDB), interest in scalable web applications, public speaker, has a girlfriend, has experience with RSI and physiotherapy, involved in tech community events (BarCamps, hackathons), critical of corporate tech practices, supports gender diversity in tech, has worked at Yahoo! and The Guardian, follows developments in web technologies and programming languages.
